Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic immunopeptidomics workflow using pan-HLA class I antibody enrichment. The search was performed without an enzyme (no-trypsin) to capture native HLA ligands. Multiple PTMs were searched, specifically highlighting a unique cysteinylation signature in mesothelioma samples.

scope: An immunoaffinity matrix was generated wherein 10 mg/ml of W6/32 pan-HLA antibody was crosslinked to 1 ml of Protein A Sepharose (PAS, CaptivA) resin as previously described and used for the immunoaffinity capture of solubilized native peptide-HLA (pHLA) complexes.
HLA class I peptides were pulled down using W6/32 (pan HLA class I) antibody bound to PAS resin.
Bound peptide-HLA complexes were eluted from the column in 10% acetic acid.
